title: Open a folding fan fully: hold one guard stick still by its tip while the other hand sweeps the other one round
instruction: Open the folding fan fully: hold one of its guard sticks still by its tip with one hand while the other hand carries the other guard stick round the rivet until the fan is spread wide. Then let go, leaving the fan lying open on its stand, and take both arms back to where they started.
context: A folding fan, like a folding rule, a swatch deck or a pair of compasses, opens about a stiff pivot: pushing one arm round moves the whole light object unless the other arm is held, so opening it takes one hand holding and the other carrying the moving arm along its arc.
setup: A table in front of two arms (bases 61 cm apart), seen by one overhead camera and a camera on each wrist. Distances are measured forward from the line between the arm bases and sideways from the midpoint between them. (1) A round beech display stand 25 cm across and 3 cm tall, topped with burgundy felt, its middle 20 cm forward on the centre line; fixed. (2) On it, a folding fan lying half open (75 degrees) with its brass rivet over the stand's middle: two black lacquered wooden guard sticks 17.5 cm long, 1.3 cm wide and 6 mm thick with gilt tips, and six bamboo ribs 15 cm long between them, all on the rivet, with a crimson-and-cream painted paper leaf from 7 to 15 cm out. One guard stick points 78 degrees to the left of straight ahead, the other 3 degrees left of straight ahead; both tips reach 4-5 cm beyond the stand's edge. Fully open, the fan spreads 150 degrees. The layout is the same in every trial, as in the screenshot.
scoring: Judged at the end. The fan's spread is the angle between its two guard sticks (75 degrees as it lies, 150 at most). It lies on its stand when its rivet is on the stand's top (within 11.5 cm of the stand's middle, at most 1.2 cm above the felt) and no stick is tilted more than 15 degrees. 1.0 with the fan spread at least 135 degrees, lying on its stand, and both arms back where they started (each TCP within 5 cm of its start); 0.5 with the fan spread at least 135 degrees and lying on its stand; 0.25 with it spread at least 110 degrees; else 0.0. The trial ends at the run limit, or once the full score has held for 1 s with every stick of the fan still.
reset_notes: The fan back half open on its stand, as at the start.
fidelity: Rigid-body simulation (Isaac Sim 6.1, PhysX, 20 Hz control). Simplified: the sticks are rigid bars on hinges about the rivet; the leaf is drawn on them and has no stiffness of its own. The stiff rivet is a spring at each fold (0.04 N m per degree) whose rest angle moves to where the fold is pushed once it gives by 1 degree, so the fan stays where it is left. Cameras 1280 x 704 (Dream-1 sees 320 x 176).
